def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Input validation
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must not be boolean")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a numeric scalar")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative")

    for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, "logp_with_result"),
                      (logp_call_only, "logp_call_only"),
                      (logp_no_call, "logp_no_call")]:
        if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
        if arr.ndim != 2:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must be 2-dimensional")
        if arr.size == 0:
            raise ValueError(f"{name} must not be empty")
        if not np.isfinite(arr).all():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
        if (arr > 0).any():
            raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")

    if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
        raise ValueError("Arrays must have the same shape")

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape

    # Compute normalized decreasing weights
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0, 1 - 0.2 * t)
    normalized_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()

    # Weighted future-token losses
    L_plus = logp_with_result @ normalized_weights
    L_call_only = logp_call_only @ normalized_weights
    L_no_call = logp_no_call @ normalized_weights

    # Counterfactual baseline: min of the two without result
    L_minus = np.minimum(L_no_call, L_call_only)

    # Margin and threshold
    margin = L_minus - L_plus
    keep = margin >= tau_filter

    return keep, margin
